Six weeks, six films, a short reading each. Pitch it as film literacy so
it survives a budget conversation.

The actual argument — that horror is the genre that looks at what people
avoid, and that a public library is exactly where that should be free —
does not go in the proposal.

summary: Six weeks of six horror films, pitched as film literacy to survive the budget
title: A proposal for a horror reading group at the branch
